review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no definitions and no simp lemmas or attributes. Its only simp uses are `simp [Metric.mem_eball, hedist, e]` in the private helper and two `simpa using h hs` calls. The `edist_def` lemmas in Wasserstein/Space.lean (lines 195–196 and 466–467) are already tagged `@[simp]`. The `simpa` calls rewrite a pulled-back measurable set, and nothing in the sources shows a loop, a competing rule or an unwanted expansion. The helper's explicit hypothesis `hedist` is passed as a simp argument, which is appropriate because it is a local assumption. I did not run Lean, so I can't rule out minor simp-set fragility, but I found no concrete improvement to the simp interface.
